title: Collection, Storage and Completion Terms of Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements
content:
# Collection, storage and completion terms

When your agreement under Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements is paid up, these plan terms govern how the merchandise is handed over, how long it is held for you without charge, what storage costs after that, whether a protection plan may be added before you collect, and when loyalty points are earned.

| Plan | Identification checked at collection | Collection by someone other than the customer | Days held after payoff before storage is charged | Storage per started month after that (USD) | Protection plan may be added before payoff | Loyalty points earned on payoff rather than as payments arrive |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30-Day Hold Agreement | yes | yes | 14 | 15.00 | no | yes |
| 90-Day Layaway | yes | yes | 30 | 20.00 | yes | yes |
| 6-Month Layaway | yes | yes | 30 | 25.00 | yes | yes |
| 12-Month Bridal Layaway | yes | no | 45 | 35.00 | yes | yes |
| Special Order Layaway | yes | no | 21 | 30.00 | yes | yes |
| Gift Registry Layaway | yes | yes | 60 | 25.00 | yes | yes |

## Your questions answered

**May someone else collect for me?** On the 30-Day Hold Agreement, the 90-Day Layaway, the 6-Month Layaway and the Gift Registry Layaway, yes. On the 12-Month Bridal Layaway and the Special Order Layaway, no.

**How long is the paid-up piece held without charge?** For the plan's holding period in calendar days shown above; storage at the plan's monthly rate is charged for each started month it stays after that.

**Can a protection plan be added to the piece before I collect it?** On every plan except the 30-Day Hold Agreement.

**When are loyalty points earned?** On every plan, when the agreement is paid up rather than as the payments arrive.
